dj.line:
A pool that walks in with the rake already on a hinge — 8388608 gives the house a dial, and it can turn it while your chips are still sliding across the felt. Crooked play rarely advertises itself this plainly; this one's holding the number up on purpose.

When the figure on the sign isn't the figure at the cashier's window, whose word are you actually betting on?
